visual_description: A heavy-duty black and yellow padded harness with multiple steel D-rings. It features specialized gear loops currently holding a rock hammer and a water bottle. A 'descender' device is clipped to the front, with a thick static climbing rope threaded through it.

constraints.material: High-strength nylon webbing; forged steel hardware; dusty appearance.
constraints.logic: Safety requirement for any slope over 45 degrees.
